title: GLiNER2 span beyond window crashes typed-entities run
description: extract typed-entities with the gliner2 backend raises IndexError in _trim_span when the model returns a span whose end exceeds the window (offset drift on unusual Unicode). One malformed span failed a 1,375-document run. Expected: spans are clamped to the window, wholly out-of-range spans are dropped and counted in a log message; never fails the document.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Typed extraction survives malformed spans
  Scenario: Span past the window end
    Given the GLiNER2 model returns a span whose end exceeds the window
    When typed entities are extracted
    Then the span is clamped to the window and the run completes
  Scenario: Span wholly outside the window
    Given the GLiNER2 model returns a span starting past the window end
    When typed entities are extracted
    Then the span is dropped, counted in a log message, and the run completes

comments.author: home
comments.text: Spec red (IndexError), then fixed: _SpanAudit clamps spans to the window, drops wholly-outside spans, logs one warning per item with adjusted/dropped counts; relations drop when either endpoint is dropped. Scenario added to typed_entity_extraction.feature. Running full coverage suite.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Full suite: new scenario green, typed_extraction_backends.py 100% line+branch. 22 unrelated scenarios fail locally from missing wikitext2 fixture / optional deps (total 97% locally); CI has them.
